summary: Destructor-style cleanup of several heterogeneous container lists on one object (this-call, no return value). Walks and frees four singly-linked node lists whose heads live at this+0xCC, this+0xD0, this+0xD4 and this+0xD8, each node freed with DualConditionalFree followed by FreeWrapper_7bcf and advanced via node[6]. Then drains a singly-linked list of vtable objects headed at this+0x90: each iteration stores StructFieldAccessor(head) back into this+0x90 and invokes the first vtable entry on the object with a single argument of 1 (release/shutdown); the head is then zeroed. Finally walks a list of owned-data nodes headed at this+0x54: reads the node's data pointer and a byte flag at node+8 and a next pointer at node+4, frees owned data chains via FreeWrapper_7bcf when the flag is set, frees each node, and zeroes this+0x54 through this+0x60. Called by sub_485EB0.
